sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports
sections.what: Brings in the tab state tool, icons, and the live match panel.
sections.why: Likely reason: the live panel is reused here rather than rewritten.
sections.watch_out: Changes to the live panel affect this tab directly.

sections.name: PlayerInfo
sections.title: Player shape
sections.what: Describes one entry in a team: its id, the player id, and the player's name, role and credits.
sections.why: Describes the team data so the cards know their fields.
sections.watch_out: Role names are compared as exact text, so a typo gives no icon and a wrong label.

sections.name: ExistingTeam, TabKey
sections.title: Team shape and tab names
sections.what: Describes the existing team with captain, vice-captain, total points and players. Lists the two tab names.
sections.why: Describes the server data and fixes the allowed tabs.
sections.watch_out: Total points are shown only when above zero, so a true zero total is hidden.

sections.name: MatchContestTabs (part 1)
sections.title: Tab setup and role icons
sections.what: Accepts the team details, sets the default tab to live, defines the two tab buttons and a helper that picks an icon for each role.
sections.why: Reason for the live default is not stated in the code.
sections.watch_out: An unknown role falls back to a plain dot icon without any warning.

sections.name: MatchContestTabs (part 2)
sections.title: Team and live tab content
sections.what: The team tab shows each player with a role icon, name, role and credits, marks the captain and vice-captain, and shows total points when positive. The live tab shows the live match panel.
sections.why: Likely reason: lets a player review the team and check the live score in one place.
sections.watch_out: The live panel is shown without the match id, so the match displayed depends on the panel's own choice.

summary: A two-tab panel that shows a visitor's own playing eleven, with captain and vice-captain marks, or the live match panel.
purpose: Lets a player review their team for one match and check the live score in one place.
why: Reason for the live tab opening first is not stated in the code.
how: 1. Keeps which tab is active. 2. On the YOUR TEAM tab, shows a card for each player with a captain or vice-captain mark, and the total points when above zero. 3. On the LIVE MATCH tab, shows the LiveMatchCenter panel.
inputs: The match id, two team names, the existing team (players, captain, vice-captain and total points), the crew id and the member count.
outputs: Tab buttons, player cards, the total points figure, and the live panel.
risks: The live tab opens first by default. The live tab is shown without the match id, so it shows whichever match the panel chooses. The crew id and member count are accepted but not used in the visible lines.
debug: If a player shows the wrong captain mark, check the captain and vice-captain ids in the team data. If the live tab shows a different match, remember that the match id is not passed to it.
